message:
Strengthen the irreducibility counter-models to the full stated-axiom register

The A12 and A15 counter-models now instance the complete stated-axiom
register (Spinoza's A1-A7 with the Section I definitional bridges)
together with the PSR augmentation, while still falsifying A12 and A15
— previously they instanced only the bare predicate signature. A new
§1.4 situates the contribution relative to prior machine-checked
philosophy (computational metaphysics). Paper prose, docs, and the
build are synced accordingly.
